description: This file defines an enum class VoiceWakeMode with three modes (Off, Foreground, Always) and a companion object providing a method to parse raw string values into enum instances.

classes.name: VoiceWakeMode
classes.description: Enum class representing different voice wake modes with associated raw string values.

methods.name: VoiceWakeMode.fromRawValue
methods.description: Converts a raw string value to a corresponding VoiceWakeMode enum, defaulting to Foreground if no match is found.
